rules.empty_map_semantics: No TIVERIT-to-ISO alignment claims have yet been verified under this gateway. Empty does not mean conflict or nonconformance.
rules.no_inference: Do not infer a mapping from terminology similarity or from the existence of an ISO reference.
rules.applicability_required: A mapping does not make the external standard applicable to a project. Applicability must be established independently by a governing instrument.
rules.exact_clause_boundary: If an exact protected clause must be verified and authorized access is unavailable, record not_yet_verified rather than inventing or reconstructing the clause.

provenance.migration_note: Creates the alignment mechanism without asserting any unverified ISO-to-TIVERIT equivalence.
